notes: This paper derives new COBE-FIRAS constraints on dark photon kinetic mixing parameter ϵ as a function of dark photon mass m_A' in the range 10^-10 to 10^-4 eV using CMB spectral distortions from photon-to-dark-photon oscillations (γ→A'). The analysis uses the Green's function method for photon injection/removal, improving on previous treatments that either assumed free-streaming or pure energy removal. The constraint is mass-dependent and varies across different cosmological eras (free-streaming, y-era, μ-y transition, μ-era, T-era). Data points extracted from Fig. 4 (solid colored line at 95% CL). The paper also provides PIXIE projections (dashed line) but those are marked as projections. The coupling type is DarkPhoton because the paper constrains kinetic mixing ϵ between the SM photon and a hidden sector dark photon. Extraction confidence is 0.75 because while the coupling type is unambiguous, the exact numerical values from the figure require careful reading of the mass-dependent curve, and some uncertainty exists in the μ-y transition region (2×10^-8 to 3×10^-6 eV) where approximations are used. | selector: text (sole candidate)
